name: AugLagrangian
stmt: def AugLagrangian (L_CE : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (x μ : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: L_CE x + (a * x - b) ^ 2 + μ * (a * x - b)

name: auglag_mu_derivative
stmt:
lemma auglag_mu_derivative (L_CE : ℝ → ℝ) (a b x p : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun μ : ℝ => AugLagrangian L_CE a b x μ) p = a * x - b
proof:
by
  unfold AugLagrangian
                                     
  have hconst : HasDerivAt (fun μ : ℝ => L_CE x + (a * x - b) ^ 2) 0 p :=
    hasDerivAt_const p _
                          
  have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun μ : ℝ => μ * (a * x - b)) (a * x - b) p := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id p).mul_const (a * x - b)
  have hadd : HasDerivAt (fun μ : ℝ => L_CE x + (a * x - b) ^ 2 + μ * (a * x - b))
      (0 + (a * x - b)) p := hconst.add hlin
  simpa using hadd.deriv

name: PMix_stationarity_implies_satisfied
stmt:
theorem PMix_stationarity_implies_satisfied (L_CE : ℝ → ℝ) (a b x : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun μ : ℝ => AugLagrangian L_CE a b x μ) x = 0 → a * x = b
proof:
by
  intro h
  rw [auglag_mu_derivative L_CE a b x x] at h
  linarith

name: auglag_x_derivative
stmt:
lemma auglag_x_derivative (L_CE : ℝ → ℝ) (a b x μ : ℝ)
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ L_CE x) :
    deriv (fun y : ℝ => AugLagrangian L_CE a b y μ) x =
      deriv L_CE x + 2 * a * (a * x - b) + μ * a
proof:
by
  unfold AugLagrangian
                                                      
  have h₁ : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => L_CE y) (deriv L_CE x) x := hd.hasDerivAt
  have h₂ : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (a * y - b) ^ 2) (2 * a * (a * x - b)) x := by
    have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => a * y - b) a x := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul a).sub (hasDerivAt_const x b)
    have hpow : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (a * y - b) ^ 2) (2 * (a * x - b) * a) x := by
      simpa using hlin.pow 2
    simpa [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hpow
  have h₃ : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => μ * (a * y - b)) (μ * a) x := by
    have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => a * y - b) a x := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul a).sub (hasDerivAt_const x b)
    simpa using hinner.const_mul μ
         
  have h₁₂ : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => L_CE y + (a * y - b) ^ 2)
      (deriv L_CE x + 2 * a * (a * x - b)) x := h₁.add h₂
  have h₀ : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => L_CE y + (a * y - b) ^ 2 + μ * (a * y - b))
      (deriv L_CE x + 2 * a * (a * x - b) + μ * a) x := h₁₂.add h₃
  exact h₀.deriv

name: PMix_multiplier_makes_stationary
stmt:
theorem PMix_multiplier_makes_stationary (L_CE : ℝ → ℝ) (a b x : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hx : a * x = b) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ L_CE x) :
    deriv (fun y : ℝ => AugLagrangian L_CE a b y (-deriv L_CE x / a)) x = 0
proof:
by
                                                                   
  rw [auglag_x_derivative L_CE a b x (-deriv L_CE x / a) hd]
  have hterm : 2 * a * (a * x - b) = 0 := by
    rw [hx]
    ring
  have hmu : (-deriv L_CE x / a) * a = -deriv L_CE x := by
    field_simp [ha]
  rw [hterm, hmu]
  ring

name: PMix_stationarity_characterization
stmt:
theorem PMix_stationarity_characterization (L_CE : ℝ → ℝ) (a b x μ : ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ L_CE x) :
    (deriv (fun y : ℝ => AugLagrangian L_CE a b y μ) x = 0 ∧
     deriv (fun μ' : ℝ => AugLagrangian L_CE a b x μ') μ = 0) ↔
    a * x = b ∧ μ = -deriv L_CE x / a
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hx, hμ⟩
                                                     
    have hsat : a * x = b := PMix_stationarity_implies_satisfied L_CE a b x (by
                                          
      rw [auglag_mu_derivative L_CE a b x x]
      rw [← auglag_mu_derivative L_CE a b x μ]
      exact hμ)
    have hxder : deriv L_CE x + 2 * a * (a * x - b) + μ * a = 0 := by
      rwa [auglag_x_derivative L_CE a b x μ hd] at hx
    have hmu : μ = -deriv L_CE x / a := by
      have hterm : 2 * a * (a * x - b) = 0 := by
        rw [hsat]
        ring
      have : μ * a = -deriv L_CE x := by
        rw [hterm] at hxder
        linarith
      calc
        μ = (μ * a) / a := by rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ μ ha]
        _ = (-deriv L_CE x) / a := by rw [this]
        _ = -deriv L_CE x / a := by ring
    exact ⟨hsat, hmu⟩
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hsat, hmu⟩
    constructor
    ·                   
      rw [hmu]
      exact PMix_multiplier_makes_stationary L_CE a b x ha hsat hd
    ·                           
      rw [auglag_mu_derivative L_CE a b x μ]
      linarith

end Lattice

name: AugLagrangianN
stmt: def AugLagrangianN (L_CE : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : Fin n → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: L_CE x + (∑ i : Fin n, (a i * x - b i) ^ 2) + (∑ i : Fin n, μ i * (a i * x - b i))

name: auglagN_mu_derivative
stmt:
lemma auglagN_mu_derivative (L_CE : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : Fin n → ℝ) (x : ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    deriv (fun m : ℝ => AugLagrangianN L_CE a b (Function.update μ i m) x) (μ i) = a i * x - b i
proof:
by
                                                 
  have hd : ∀ j : Fin n, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun m : ℝ => (Function.update μ i m) j * (a j * x - b j)) (μ i) := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      simpa using ((differentiableAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) (x := μ i)).mul_const (a i * x - b i))
    · have hf : (fun m : ℝ => (Function.update μ i m) j * (a j * x - b j))
          = fun _ : ℝ => μ j * (a j * x - b j) := by
        funext m
        rw [Function.update_noteq hj]
      rw [hf]
      exact differentiableAt_const _
  have hlin : deriv (fun m : ℝ => ∑ j : Fin n, (Function.update μ i m) j * (a j * x - b j)) (μ i)
      = a i * x - b i := by
    rw [deriv_sum (u := Finset.univ) (A := fun j m => (Function.update μ i m) j * (a j * x - b j)) (x := μ i) (fun j hj => hd j)]
    calc
      (∑ j : Fin n, deriv (fun m : ℝ => (Function.update μ i m) j * (a j * x - b j)) (μ i))
          = deriv (fun m : ℝ => (Function.update μ i m) i * (a i * x - b i)) (μ i) := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_single i
            · intro j hj hji
              have hf : (fun m : ℝ => (Function.update μ i m) j * (a j * x - b j))
                  = fun _ : ℝ => μ j * (a j * x - b j) := by
                funext m
                rw [Function.update_noteq hji]
              rw [hf, deriv_const]
            · intro hi
              exact False.elim (hi (Finset.mem_univ i))
      _ = a i * x - b i := by
            have hf : (fun m : ℝ => (Function.update μ i m) i * (a i * x - b i

name: PMixN_stationarity_implies_satisfied
stmt:
theorem PMixN_stationarity_implies_satisfied (L_CE : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : Fin n → ℝ)
    (μ : Fin n → ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    (∀ i : Fin n, deriv (fun m : ℝ => AugLagrangianN L_CE a b (Function.update μ i m) x) (μ i) = 0)
      → ∀ i : Fin n, a i * x = b i
proof:
by
  intro h i
  have hderiv := auglagN_mu_derivative L_CE a b μ x i
  have hi : deriv (fun m : ℝ => AugLagrangianN L_CE a b (Function.update μ i m) x) (μ i) = 0 := h i
  rw [hderiv] at hi
  linarith

name: auglagN_x_derivative
stmt:
lemma auglagN_x_derivative (L_CE : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : Fin n → ℝ) (x : ℝ)
    (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ L_CE x) :
    deriv (fun y : ℝ => AugLagrangianN L_CE a b μ y) x =
      deriv L_CE x + (∑ i : Fin n, 2 * a i * (a i * x - b i)) + (∑ i : Fin n, μ i * a i)
proof:
by
                                        
  have hps_i : ∀ i : Fin n, HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (a i * y - b i) ^ 2)
      (2 * a i * (a i * x - b i)) x := by
    intro i
    have hdsq_i : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ => (a i * y - b i) ^ 2) x := by
      have hlin_i : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : ℝ => a i * y - b i) x := by
        simpa using ((differentiableAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) (x := x)).const_mul (a i)).sub (differentiableAt_const (b i))
      exact hlin_i.pow 2
    rw [← deriv_sq_linear (a i) (b i) x]
    exact hdsq_i.hasDerivAt
                                    
  have hlin_i : ∀ i : Fin n, HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => μ i * (a i * y - b i)) (μ i * a i) x := by
    intro i
    have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => a i * y - b i) (a i) x := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul (a i)).sub (hasDerivAt_const x (b i))
    simpa using hinner.const_mul (μ i)
       
  have hps : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => ∑ i : Fin n, (a i * y - b i) ^ 2)
      (∑ i : Fin n, 2 * a i * (a i * x - b i)) x := by
    simpa using (HasDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun i hi => hps_i i))
  have hls : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => ∑ i : Fin n, μ i * (a i * y - b i))
      (∑ i : Fin n, μ i * a i) x := by
    simpa using (HasDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun i hi => hlin_i i))
  have hce : HasDerivAt L_CE (deriv L_CE x) x := hd.hasDerivAt
         
  have hsum := hce.add hps
  have hsum2 := hsum.add hls
  simpa [AugLagrangianN] using hsum2.deriv

name: lagrange
doc: Lagrange 基函数：`lagrange x i t = ∏_{j ≠ i} (t - x j)/(x i - x j)`。
stmt: def lagrange (x : n → ℝ) (i : n) (t : ℝ) : ℝ
proof: ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (t - x j) / (x i - x j)

name: lagrange_at_self
doc: 节点互异时，`lagrange x i` 在自身节点处取 1。
stmt:
theorem lagrange_at_self {x : n → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → x i ≠ x j) (i : n) :
    lagrange x i (x i) = 1
proof:
by
  unfold lagrange
  refine Finset.prod_eq_one ?_
  intro j hj
  have hji : j ≠ i := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
  have hne : x i - x j ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm (hx j i hji))
  exact div_self hne

name: lagrange_at_other
doc: 节点互异时，`lagrange x i` 在其它节点处取 0（其实只需 `i ≠ j`：分子含零因子）。
stmt:
theorem lagrange_at_other {x : n → ℝ} {i j : n} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    lagrange x i (x j) = 0
proof:
by
  unfold lagrange
  have hmem : j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i :=
    Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hij, Finset.mem_univ j⟩
  exact Finset.prod_eq_zero hmem (by simp)

name: lagrange_cardinal
doc: Cardinal 性质：`lagrange x i (x j) = if i = j then 1 else 0`。
stmt:
theorem lagrange_cardinal {x : n → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → x i ≠ x j) (i j : n) :
    lagrange x i (x j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
by
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h
    simp [lagrange_at_self hx i]
  · simp [h, lagrange_at_other h]

name: lagrange_interpolates
doc: **主定理**：插值算子在节点上等于恒等——任意 `f` 在节点处被精确重构。
stmt:
theorem lagrange_interpolates {x : n → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → x i ≠ x j)
    (f : n → ℝ) (k : n) :
    ∑ i, f i * lagrange x i (x k) = f k
proof:
by
  have hkey : ∀ i, f i * lagrange x i (x k) = if i = k then f k else 0 := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = k
    · rw [hi, lagrange_at_self hx k, mul_one, if_pos rfl]
    · rw [lagrange_at_other hi, mul_zero, if_neg hi]
  calc ∑ i, f i * lagrange x i (x k)
      = ∑ i, if i = k then f k else 0 := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hkey i)
    _ = f k := by simp

name: lagrange_sum_at_node
doc: 单位分解的节点版本（由主定理取 `f ≡ 1`）。
stmt:
theorem lagrange_sum_at_node {x : n → ℝ} (hx : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → x i ≠ x j) (k : n) :
    ∑ i, lagrange x i (x k) = 1
proof:
by
  have h := lagrange_interpolates hx (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) k
  simpa using h

name: linInterp
doc: 两点线性插值：过 `(x0, y0)` 与 `(x1, y1)` 的直线在 `t` 处的值。
stmt: def linInterp (x0 x1 y0 y1 t : ℝ) : ℝ

name: linInterp_left
stmt:
theorem linInterp_left {x0 x1 y0 y1 : ℝ} (h : x0 ≠ x1) :
    linInterp x0 x1 y0 y1 x0 = y0
proof:
by
  unfold linInterp
  have h1 : x0 - x1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h
  have h2 : x1 - x0 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm h)
  field_simp

name: linInterp_right
stmt:
theorem linInterp_right {x0 x1 y0 y1 : ℝ} (h : x0 ≠ x1) :
    linInterp x0 x1 y0 y1 x1 = y1
proof:
by
  unfold linInterp
  have h1 : x0 - x1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h
  have h2 : x1 - x0 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm h)
  field_simp

name: linInterp_slope_form
doc: 斜截式改写：`linInterp = y0 + (y1 - y0)·(t - x0)/(x1 - x0)`。
stmt:
theorem linInterp_slope_form {x0 x1 y0 y1 t : ℝ} (h : x0 ≠ x1) :
    linInterp x0 x1 y0 y1 t = y0 + (y1 - y0) * (t - x0) / (x1 - x0)
proof:
by
  unfold linInterp
  have h1 : x0 - x1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h
  have h2 : x1 - x0 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm h)
  field_simp
  ring

name: linInterp_convex_form
stmt:
theorem linInterp_convex_form {x0 x1 y0 y1 t : ℝ} (h : x0 ≠ x1) :
    linInterp x0 x1 y0 y1 t = ((x1 - t) * y0 + (t - x0) * y1) / (x1 - x0)
proof:
by
  unfold linInterp
  have h1 : x0 - x1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h
  have h2 : x1 - x0 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm h)
  field_simp
  ring

name: linInterp_between
doc:
凸组合形式的意义：`t ∈ [x0,x1]`（`x0 < x1`）时插值值是两端点的凸组合，
故落在两端点值之间。这是"弦夹在函数值与端点之间"类论证的代数内核。
stmt:
theorem linInterp_between {x0 x1 y0 y1 t : ℝ} (h : x0 < x1)
    (ht0 : x0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ x1) :
    min y0 y1 ≤ linInterp x0 x1 y0 y1 t ∧ linInterp x0 x1 y0 y1 t ≤ max y0 y1
proof:
by
  rw [linInterp_convex_form (ne_of_lt h)]
  have hden : 0 < x1 - x0 := by linarith
  have hw0 : 0 ≤ (x1 - t) / (x1 - x0) := div_nonneg (by linarith) (le_of_lt hden)
  have hw1 : 0 ≤ (t - x0) / (x1 - x0) := div_nonneg (by linarith) (le_of_lt hden)
  have hsum : (x1 - t) / (x1 - x0) + (t - x0) / (x1 - x0) = 1 := by
    field_simp
  have hrewrite : ((x1 - t) * y0 + (t - x0) * y1) / (x1 - x0)
      = ((x1 - t) / (x1 - x0)) * y0 + ((t - x0) / (x1 - x0)) * y1 := by
    field_simp
  rw [hrewrite]
  constructor
  · calc min y0 y1
        = ((x1 - t) / (x1 - x0)) * min y0 y1 + ((t - x0) / (x1 - x0)) * min y0 y1 := by
          rw [← add_mul, hsum, one_mul]
      _ ≤ ((x1 - t) / (x1 - x0)) * y0 + ((t - x0) / (x1 - x0)) * y1 :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_left y0 y1) hw0)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_right y0 y1) hw1)
  · calc ((x1 - t) / (x1 - x0)) * y0 + ((t - x0) / (x1 - x0)) * y1
        ≤ ((x1 - t) / (x1 - x0)) * max y0 y1 + ((t - x0) / (x1 - x0)) * max y0 y1 :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left y0 y1) hw0)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right y0 y1) hw1)
      _ = max y0 y1 := by
          rw [← add_mul, hsum, one_mul]

end Lattice
